settings_interface_intro: Layout, scale, language, and content visibility.
settings_language_hint: Choose the language used by Izumi's interface.
settings_setup_assistant_hint: Review language, playback defaults, and connection readiness.
settings_theme_hint: Contrast-safe palettes applied across the app and player controls.
settings_motion_hint: Follow the system preference, reduce animation, or always show it.
settings_high_contrast_hint: Strengthen muted text, borders, and the keyboard focus indicator.
settings_large_targets_hint: Give keyboard and touch controls a minimum 44 × 44 px target.
settings_notifications_hint: Notify you when an episode in your watch history airs. Off by default; enabling asks for system permission.
settings_hide_spoilers_hint: Blur thumbnails, titles and ratings of aired-but-unwatched episodes.
settings_show_adult_hint: Include adult titles in browse and search results.
settings_auto_incognito_hint: Playing an adult title automatically enters incognito for that session: no tracker sync, nothing saved. Turns off when the player closes.
settings_haptics_hint: Vibrate on taps, toggles, and actions.
player_autoplay_next_hint: Play the next episode automatically when one finishes.
player_up_next_overlay_hint: Before autoplay, show a 10-second prompt with Play now and Stay controls. Off by default.
onboarding_both_body: Anime, films and series together on one home, with separate catalogs whenever you need them.
onboarding_automatic_body: Anime metadata with automatic provider fallback. No API key or tracking account needed.
onboarding_both_included: Automatic anime is included. Choose how izumi finds your films and series below.
onboarding_access_draft: Keys entered here are saved when you finish setup.
onboarding_access_help: How do I get a token?
onboarding_welcome_body: Anime, films, series — or a bit of everything. Choose what you watch and set your playback defaults.
onboarding_preferences_body: These are global fallbacks. izumi will remember changes you make for each series.
onboarding_connections_body: You can finish now and connect anything marked optional later in Settings.
onboarding_needs_source: Add at least one source before streaming
onboarding_once_detail: izumi only asks once on this device. You can rerun onboarding later from Settings → Interface.
onboarding_personalize: Make izumi feel like your library.
onboarding_change_later_hint: You can change the catalog and every other choice later in Settings.
onboarding_focus_body: This sets the starting catalog and shapes the home experience. It does not lock you in.
onboarding_anime_body: Start with seasonal anime, anime search, schedules and anime-native metadata.
onboarding_movies_body: Start with films and series, broad discovery, cast information and rich title details.
onboarding_anilist_default_body: AniList is izumi’s most complete anime-first catalog. Browsing does not require an account.
onboarding_metadata_body: TMDB provides izumi’s richer experience. Stremio metadata is a keyless alternative with fewer guarantees.
onboarding_tmdb_body: Richer movie and series results, artwork, cast, recommendations and detail pages.
onboarding_stremio_body: Use Cinemeta and compatible Stremio add-ons without creating a TMDB API credential.
onboarding_stremio_warning: May return less metadata and support fewer izumi features than TMDB.
onboarding_tmdb_access_body: You can continue without entering keys. To use TMDB in a public build, add your personal API Read Access Token before browsing its catalog; the ratings key only adds external ratings.
onboarding_tmdb_instruction_1: Create or sign in to a free TMDB account in a desktop browser.
onboarding_tmdb_instruction_2: Open Account Settings → API, request a key and choose the Developer option.
onboarding_tmdb_instruction_3: Complete TMDB’s application details for your personal, non-commercial use.
onboarding_tmdb_instruction_4: Copy the long value labelled API Read Access Token and paste it here.
onboarding_tmdb_token_hint: Stored on this device. You can leave it blank and add it later in Settings → Catalog.
onboarding_omdb_key_hint: Adds IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes and Metacritic ratings when available. It is not required for TMDB metadata.
onboarding_tmdb_attribution: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
onboarding_external_error: Could not open the page. Please try again in your browser.
onboarding_stremio_sync_body: Already use Stremio? Sign in to sync your installed add-ons and their configuration, so you can set up faster.
onboarding_stremio_credentials_hint: Your password is only used to sign in and is never saved. Your Stremio connection is saved immediately.
onboarding_stremio_synced: Add-ons synced: {count}. Your sources are available in Settings → Sources.
onboarding_stremio_empty: Your account has no compatible add-ons yet. You can add sources later in Settings → Sources.
onboarding_stremio_sync_pending: Your account is connected. Retry syncing your sources here, or later in Settings → Accounts.
onboarding_stremio_sync_error: Could not sync your Stremio sources. Please try again.
onboarding_stremio_connected_hint: Your Stremio add-ons will stay in sync between both apps. Manage the connection in Settings → Accounts.
onboarding_stremio_optional_hint: No Stremio account? Continue below and add sources later in Settings. Connecting keeps your Stremio add-ons in sync between both apps; tracking accounts are set up separately.
onboarding_stremio_skipped: Not connected. You can add sources or connect Stremio later in Settings.
onboarding_stremio_access_body: izumi will enable Cinemeta as your starting Stremio metadata catalog. You can add or replace compatible add-ons later.
onboarding_no_key_body: Cinemeta is added automatically, so you can start browsing after setup.
onboarding_stremio_limit_body: Stremio add-ons choose which catalogs, metadata fields and resources they expose. Results can be less complete, and some izumi discovery or detail features may be unavailable.
onboarding_anilist_access_body: No API key is required to browse. Connecting a tracking account is separate and remains optional.
onboarding_anilist_no_key_body: Browse with AniList immediately. You can connect AniList, MyAnimeList, Kitsu or Simkl later for tracking.
onboarding_review_body: Review the starting experience izumi will apply when you finish.
onboarding_add_later: Add a token later in Settings
onboarding_review_once_hint: This completes the one-time setup. To change these choices later, open Settings → Interface and rerun onboarding.
cast_scanning: Looking for TVs on this network…
cast_empty: No Cast devices found. Make sure this computer and TV are on the same network.
lists_empty_custom: Create a custom list from any title's Save menu.
